pack.title: Navigation Basics (Example)
pack.description: Illustrative example pack: basic orientation and navigation practice. Educational sample content for the ODY format.

entries.title: Basic orientation
entries.summary: Before moving, establish where you are and which direction you need to travel.
entries.detail: Identify at least two fixed reference points and confirm your intended direction against them. Note your starting point so you can return to it.
actions: Identify at least two fixed reference points
decision_rules: If you cannot confirm your position, stop and re-orient before moving
If visibility is poor, prefer to stay put until it improves
prohibitions: Do not travel further while uncertain of your position
Do not rely on a single reference point

entries.title: Using a map and compass
entries.summary: A map and a compass complement each other: the map shows the terrain, the compass shows direction.
entries.detail: Orient the map to the terrain before reading it, and take a bearing before you start moving rather than while walking.
actions: Orient the map to the terrain
decision_rules: If map and terrain disagree, trust direct observation and re-check your position
If the compass reading is unstable, move away from metal objects and re-take the bearing
prohibitions: Do not use a compass near large metal objects or electronics
Do not follow a bearing without checking the terrain ahead

entries.title: Route discipline
entries.summary: Plan a route before starting and stick to it unless conditions clearly require a change.
entries.detail: Set simple checkpoints along the route and note the time you expect to reach each one. If you reach a checkpoint late, reassess before continuing.
actions: Reassess when a checkpoint is missed
decision_rules: If you miss a checkpoint time, reassess the plan before continuing
If conditions worsen beyond your preparation, turn back
prohibitions: Do not extend the route without a clear reason
Do not continue past your planned turnaround time
